body:
| # | Description | Level | #v5.0.be |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: |
| **5.4.3** | Verify that files obtained from untrusted sources are scanned by antivirus scanners to prevent serving of known malicious content. | 2 | v5.0.be-12.5.5 |

Things to discuss:
* untrusted - should it be limited untrusted or apply to all files?
* at the moment we defend only the end-user and serving the file content, but we don't address the situation, when the application processes the file content

---

edit: as every application may need different solution in this case, maybe we can just highlight the need for such process via documentation requirement, proposed change ni #2947

comments.body:
I like the idea of expanding this requirement for other types of application files, but would prefer to leave this requirement as stand alone instead of merging into another requirement. 

This is fairly important to get right and I don't want to see it get lost in another requirement.
If my proposal in #2947 suits, then we don't need to touch this requirement at all.
Yup, I think you are making a good call with 5.1.1 and file upload in general. I'm with you on this @elarlang and thank you for hearing out some of my earlier concerns.
At the moment I take a position, that the concern is addressed and will be solved via #2947 changes.
